records.claim: Naproxen passes into breast milk in small amounts. Using naproxen is not expected to be harmful to most breastfeeding babies. There is one report of blood-related health problems in an infant who was exposed to naproxen and another medication through breast milk. It is not known if the reported health problems were due to the naproxen, another medication, or other factors. If you suspect the baby has any symptoms (vomiting, diarrhea, bleeding, trouble with feeding, or trouble with weight gain) contact the child’s healthcare provider.
